instructions.primary_message: Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.

Place melting chocolate in a microwave safe bowl. Place bowl in the microwave and heat on 50% power or defrost setting for 1 minute. Stir, then repeat heating at 50% power for 30-second intervals, until smooth and completely melted.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (10 oz) pkg melting dark chocolate candy wafers

instructions.primary_message: Insert a toothpick into the base of a marshmallow to use as a handle, then dip the marshmallow in the melted chocolate, creating the head and wings of your "penguin." Allow excess chocolate to drip off, then place on the baking sheet. Repeat with remaining marshmallows. Set aside until chocolate is fully set, about 5 minutes.
Cut a total of 36 yellow and orange candies in half.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup chocolate peanut butter candies

instructions.primary_message: Using a dot of icing, adhere candy eyes to the marshmallows. Repeat with the halved candies to create the "beaks" and "feet" of your penguins. Set aside until icing is fully set, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1.3 oz) tube white writing icing or gel
1 (2.89 oz) pkg mini candy eyeballs

instructions.primary_message: To serve, remove toothpicks and arrange penguins on a platter. Enjoy!
